item.name: RAYHAYES RG-H17S Wireless Microphone  Rechargeable for Karaoke Speaker Mixe
item.title: RAYHAYES RG-H17S Wireless Microphone  Rechargeable for Karaoke Speaker Mixe
item.description:
Enjoy clear vocals and convenient wireless performance with the RAYHAYES RG-H17S. Designed for karaoke, home entertainment, presentations, live performances and everyday use, this dual wireless microphone system offers easy setup and stable 2.4GHz wireless connectivity.
KEY FEATURES
• 2.4GHz Wireless Technology
Stable wireless connection with low latency for smooth and reliable performance.
• Up to 50M Working Range
Move freely while singing or speaking without being restricted by cables.
Actual range may vary depending on the environment.
• Dual Wireless Microphones
Includes 2 handheld microphones, ideal for duets, family karaoke, events and presentations.
• Clear Vocal Pickup
Designed to capture vocals clearly while reducing unwanted background noise for a cleaner sound.
• USB-C Rechargeable Design
Convenient USB-C charging for both the microphone system and receiver.
• Plug & Play
Simply connect the receiver, switch on the system and start using it—no complicated setup required.
• 6.35mm Direct Connection
Compatible with many speakers, amplifiers, mixers and karaoke systems.
• 3.5mm Adapter Support
Included adapter provides more connection options for compatible audio equipment.
• Clear LED Display
Easily check channel, signal and working status at a glance.
• Durable Metal Grille
Strong microphone head design for everyday karaoke, stage and professional use.
Suitable For
Karaoke • Home Entertainment • Singing • Live Performance • Party • Speech • Presentation • Recording • Stage Use
Product Specifications
Model: RG-H17S
Wireless Technology: 2.4GHz
Modulation: Digital Modulation
Frequency Response: 30Hz–20kHz
Signal-to-Noise Ratio: >95dB
Distortion: ≤0.01%
Working Range: Up to 50 meters in ideal conditions
Charging Port: USB-C
Receiver Connection: 6.35mm
Adapter: 6.35mm to 3.5mm

RAYHAYES RG-H17S — Plug In. Power On. Perform.
